product.title: Beams Plus Open Collar Chambray Shirt - Indigo
product.body_html: If there’s a brand that reinvents the classics right, it’s Beams. Their Open Collar Shirt is made from selvedge chambray woven on a traditional shuttle loom. The silhouette is based off of a vintage US Navy utility shirt and the garment has single stitch stitching throughout for an elegant construction. With a spread collar this shirt has a relaxed edge and the straight hem allows for a boxier shape.

product.title: Beams Plus Stripe Pocket T-Shirt - Yellow
product.body_html: Another great everyday tee from Beams Plus. Their Stripe Pocket T-Shirt is made from 100% cotton, showcasing a beautiful striped pattern. They have been careful to align the stripes of the pocket for an extra touch of quality detail.

product.title: Beams Plus Indian Nel Plaid Button Down Pullover Shirt - Pink
product.body_html: The Beams Plus Plaid Shirt is the perfect layer for all year wear. Made from traditional Indian twill check fabric made on a power loom, 40 count double yarn is used for both the warp and the weft creating the heavy twill pattern. The fabric is hand-dyed and slowly woven before drying in the sun, resulting in a shirt with a rich texture. This pullover style shirt is a great way to achieve both comfort and style, layering into outfits with ease.

To top it off, Beams have embroidered their iconic + accent at the base of each side hem, for a final touch of quality assurance.

product.title: Beams Plus Band Collar Chambray Shirt - Indigo
product.body_html:
If there’s a brand that reinvents the classics right, it’s Beams. Their Band Collar Shirt has been made from rope-dyed indigo yarn, for a dynamic appearance. The shirt has a longer, slightly A-line silhouette, for a more contemporary, relaxed fit. A great combination of classic details with a modern twist.

product.title: Freenote Cloth Grafton Jacket - Black
product.body_html:
Made in homage to the iconic Eisenhower jacket - a short waist length wool jacket with large chest pockets, Freenote's Grafton jacket rethinks the design as a contemporary piece. 

Sewn with hunting style double pockets and large corozo buttons, this jacket borrows from Freenote's extensive archive of vintage examples. Remaining true to the military roots of the jacket is the 13oz Japanese jungle cloth, which has been used throughout the entirety of this garment.

A testament to the construction of this piece is the peaked top button closure allowing the lapels to function both open and closed, along with notched wait button tabs and asymmetric pocket flaps.

product.title: Freenote Sateen Work Shirt  - Chocolate
product.body_html: Masters of vintage workwear inspirations, Freenote's work shirts are a fan favourite for a reason. Constructed from a Japanese sateen twill, this shirt boasts a classic 1940s shape that we all know and love. With large patch pockets adorning the chest, custom corozo buttons and a vintage appearing stone wash, this shirt combines classic features with modern fabrications.

product.title: Knickerbocker Heavyweight T-Shirt - Milk
product.body_html:
If there's one tee thats made an impact this last decade its the heavyweight tee. New in from Knickerbocker their Heavyweight T-Shirt is a wardrobe essential. Made from 100% cotton, this weighty tee is designed to be boxy on the body. The mounted collar should prevent any stretching and provides a clean finish. 

  • 100% Cotton
  • Boxy fit 
  • Mounted collar 
  • Made in Portugal

product.title: ONI Denim L722-12 Ladies 12oz Extra Wide Straight jean - Bleach Wash
product.body_html:
For the first time, ONI Denim have released a small collection of jeans designed specifically for women. The L722-12Z is a jean designed entirely from scratch as a unique jean in and of itself; this is not a variation of a men's cut, but a dedicated jean for women. 

Cut from a 12oz denim with a light texture and slightly dry hand feel, the jeans have been treated to a bleach wash to feel perfectly worn in from day one. With a mid rise, zip fly, fitted hips and top block, and a super wide leg the L722 is bound to become your new favourite.

product.title: ONI Denim 222 'Asphalt' 20oz Extra Wide Straight Jean - One Wash
product.body_html:
This artisanal fabric by the masters of slub, ONI, boasts unique characteristics, and a super-low tension weave. Weighing in at 20 ounces, this heavyweight fabric has a thick yarn which has been woven on vintage shuttle looms, allowing the natural fibres to poke out at irregular intervals. The Asphalt name that the brand have given the fabric of course comes from its resemblance to the hard Japanese road surfaces.

The 222 shape has become a fan favourite in the denim community. Its wide leg and mid-high rise waist has proven flattering on a variety of different people. ONI's classic 5 pocket design is present, as well as: punch through copper rivets, button fly, a leather patch, and pink selvedge ID.

product.title: FULLCOUNT 2061 Relax Fit Denim Chore Jacket - One Wash
product.body_html: This new Denim Chore Jacket from FULLCOUNT draws its influence from vintage workwear. The jacket is made from 12 oz. Zimbabwe & Australian cotton denim which has been given a cotton lining for superior comfort. The silhouette of this jacket is oversized leaving plenty of room for layering underneath. Spiral shaped buttons adorn the placket whilst a 8-Wale corduroy collar adds a subtle touch of refinement.

product.title: FULLCOUNT 3741 'Mother Cotton' Sweatshirt - Ecru
product.body_html:
This incredible heritage sweatshirt has been cut from a luxuriously soft 100% cotton jersey, which has been masterfully woven on vintage loop-wheel knitting machines. This method of fabric production is labour and time intensive, but produces a quality of material which is unparalleled.

With a short cut, boxy shape this sweat cuts an iconic mid century silhouette. Ribbed necking, cuffs, and waistband add to the perfect comfort fit, while a ‘double v’ collar add heritage authenticity. A super soft high pile finish on the inside will make you never want to be without your new favourite sweat!

product.title: Jackman GG Crewneck Sweatshirt - Retro Olive
product.body_html:
The unique slubby texture of this sweatshirt really stands it out from the crowd, as Jackman have delicately blended traditional detailing, with modern elements of design. A slightly oversized fit on this sweat adds to its comfortable feel, while a heavyweight cotton allows the fabric to gently mould to your body over time, with greater comfort in every wear.

A set in sleeve allows the shoulder to drop slightly, enhancing the relaxed appearance, while ribbed cuffs and waistband offer the perfect comfort fit. A ‘Single V’ collar insert has been added for a touch of heritage detail, and a custom woven cotton brand label serves as a badge of quality assurance.
